parsed.rationale: Both records are unnamed `extension` declarations on (presumably) `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package, surfaced by the name-collisions query. Having two separate files in `Shared/Caching/Sources/Caching/` extend the same type creates split-definition risk: members can shadow or conflict silently, and readers must consult two files to understand the full surface. Since both extensions live in the same package and neither carries any restraint markers (all context flags false), consolidating them into a single canonical file — `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift`, which already signals WXYC-specific augmentation — is the idiomatic Swift approach. The `DefaultsStorage.swift` extension members should be moved there and the extension block in `DefaultsStorage.swift` removed (the `DefaultsStorage` type itself, if any, may remain in that file).
